job.name: ig36_host
job.style: Photorealistic night-time phone video still from inside a car, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~34 за рулём ночью, снято с телефона на приборной панели, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: мужчина ~34 в машине ночью говорит в камеру
job.prompt: Horizontal 16:9 photorealistic frame, as if filmed by a phone mounted on the dashboard. A Russian man about 34 with short dark hair, a full neat dark beard, a dark olive bomber jacket over a black hoodie, sits in the driver seat of a parked car at night, his body turned slightly toward the camera, looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm serious face, NO smile, one hand resting on the steering wheel. Framing: he is on the left third of the frame, head and shoulders and chest fully visible, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge. Behind him through the side window: dark night city with warm street lights and a lit building, soft bokeh. Dim warm interior light on his face, deep shadows, realistic low-light phone camera look, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
